claim: NOAA publishes annual versioned Storm Events bulk files
evidence_summary: Annual details filenames contain event year and creation date
limitations: Historical files may be revised
conclusion_or_follow_up: Store snapshots and select latest imported revision

claim: NOAA tornado dimensions can refer to a segment
evidence_summary: Descriptions explicitly allow tornado or tornado segment
limitations: Source record count is not a count of unique tornadoes
conclusion_or_follow_up: Keep source records separate from curated exhibits

claim: NOAA bulk format guide has a suspect EF wind table
evidence_summary: Table labels categories EF but gives values inconsistent with current NWS EF guidance
limitations: This does not establish that the underlying category records are wrong
conclusion_or_follow_up: Do not derive wind speed from that table

claim: EF categories are damage-based wind estimates
evidence_summary: Explains estimated three-second gusts and EF category ranges
limitations: Category does not establish actual measured wind or funnel appearance
conclusion_or_follow_up: Keep rating separate from measured wind and visual dimensions

claim: JMA catalogue includes several kinds of gust phenomena
evidence_summary: Code 1 is tornado and other codes include downburst and uncertain combinations
limitations: Current catalogue has not been normalized by this project
conclusion_or_follow_up: Build dedicated classification and sentinel handling

claim: JMA content reuse requires attribution and labeling modifications
evidence_summary: Identifies public data terms attribution and modification notices
limitations: Exceptions apply and linked full public data terms need publication review
conclusion_or_follow_up: Review applicable terms and media rights before publication

claim: International Fujita ratings should retain their original scale
evidence_summary: Discusses differences in wind definitions and handling of older ratings
limitations: Not a universal conversion table between scales
conclusion_or_follow_up: Preserve F EF IF JEF and TORRO identities

claim: El Reno has substantial official material for a possible exhibit
source_title: May 31 2013 tornado and flash flood event
evidence_summary: Provides event chronology maps and discussion of radar and damage
limitations: Appearance reconstruction and photograph rights remain unreviewed
conclusion_or_follow_up: First geographic exhibit implemented using published KMZ; shot registration still needed

claim: Northern Eurasia has a research catalogue spanning historical records
source_title: Tornadoes in Northern Eurasia From the Middle Age to the Information Era
evidence_summary: Potential source for former USSR region and historical uncertainty
limitations: Full article access returned 403 and dataset reuse not checked
conclusion_or_follow_up: Locate accessible authorized data and verify terms before import

claim: NWS El Reno KMZ contains timed center positions
evidence_summary: 39 point labels plus one path and one polygon; XML time order needs sorting
limitations: No per-position error bounds supplied; AM/PM and time zone inferred from accompanying chronology
conclusion_or_follow_up: Preserve original bytes and geographic sequences; show discrete positions

claim: A caption differs from the final rating description
access_level: description partial captions and sampled stills
evidence_summary: Caption says EF5 while current description says EF3
limitations: Caption text was read; audio was not independently checked
conclusion_or_follow_up: Use final official rating; review historical correction context

claim: Swegle glowing tornado video covers Blackwell 1955
source_title: The Night a Tornado Started Glowing
evidence_summary: Description identifies 1955 Blackwell Oklahoma
limitations: No full video review or physical mechanism validation
conclusion_or_follow_up: Pair with historical accounts and the TornadoTRX lead

claim: El Reno end times differ across source components
source_title: El Reno event account and tornado table
access_level: full text and local NCEI record
locator: event narrative versus tabulated end time
evidence_summary: Narrative gives 6:42 PM CDT; table and NCEI 453682 give equivalent of 6:44 PM CDT
limitations: Unresolved source discrepancy
conclusion_or_follow_up: Retain both endings; geographic timeline ends at its final 6:42 label

claim: NWS distinguishes government data from licensed third-party imagery
locator: Use of NOAA/NWS Data and Products; mapping data
evidence_summary: Original government data generally public domain; third-party material may differ
limitations: Do not imply endorsement or label modifications as official
conclusion_or_follow_up: Attribute original geometry and label this independent adaptation

claim: Natural Earth permits redistribution and adaptation of its map data
evidence_summary: Vector and raster map data are public domain
limitations: Modern boundaries do not describe historical jurisdiction
conclusion_or_follow_up: Preserve geometry and provenance; reduce attributes to display name

claim: El Reno research has used registered multi-view chaser imagery
source_title: El Reno Survey Project conference abstract
evidence_summary: Describes fixing imagery time and location before combining synchronous perspectives
limitations: Presentation not reviewed and our video samples remain unregistered
conclusion_or_follow_up: Use explicit shot locators and unresolved camera/time fields

claim: A later paper develops the El Reno imagery collation method
publisher_or_author: Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
evidence_summary: Discusses timing and location registration of contributed imagery
limitations: Direct article access returned 403; survey website timed out
conclusion_or_follow_up: Obtain authorized full text before claiming its complete method is implemented

claim: Joplin source segments use locality names distinct from the common event name
evidence_summary: Central City narrative names Joplin; Saginaw narrative identifies its continuation
limitations: Two reviewed aliases do not establish a complete grouping of the tornado
conclusion_or_follow_up: Keep EF5 Jasper and EF2 Newton segment ratings separate

claim: NWS identifies its El Reno survey photograph set as government personnel work
access_level: damage section read; original JPEGs preserved
evidence_summary: Source explicitly credits NWS/NOAA personnel and identifies subjects with EF2 or EF3 assessments
limitations: Other images on the same page have third-party credits; exact camera coordinates and capture times are not supplied
conclusion_or_follow_up: Bundle only the nine reviewed structure and infrastructure images; preserve hashes and attribution

claim: A tornado appearance alone does not establish its intensity
evidence_summary: Moisture and cloud-base height influence appearance; visual form alone should not determine wind speed or rating
limitations: Does not validate the procedural illustration or prescribe its geometry
conclusion_or_follow_up: Keep visual presets independent from ratings and historical measurements

claim: Condensation dust and debris help make tornadoes visible
evidence_summary: Wind is invisible; water droplets dust and debris can make a tornado visible
limitations: Direct page retrieval failed with 502; no full page review in this pass
conclusion_or_follow_up: Use only the narrow visibility explanation; do not attribute a physical model to the source

claim: NOAA hosts an aerial survey and mobile radar study of El Reno 2013
source_title: Aerial Damage Survey of the 2013 El Reno Tornado Combined with Mobile Radar Data
evidence_summary: Describes combining aerial damage evidence with mobile radar observations
limitations: Full PDF not yet reviewed; rights metadata is Other and is not a redistribution license
conclusion_or_follow_up: Read the full paper before adopting a registration method or reproducing any figures

claim: El Reno source record reports 8 direct deaths and 26 direct injuries
evidence_summary: DEATHS_DIRECT 8; INJURIES_DIRECT 26; indirect values zero
limitations: Published record scope; not a reconciled total across other reporting
conclusion_or_follow_up: Display source revision and preserve different regional reporting scope

claim: NOAA names the three TWISTEX researchers killed near El Reno
source_title: NOAA statement on deaths of storm researchers
evidence_summary: Tim Samaras; Paul Samaras; Carl Young
limitations: Does not provide the full eight-person roster
conclusion_or_follow_up: Use these names with source links in remembrance

claim: Contemporary reporting provides additional victim names
source_title: Breakdown of the storm fatalities in Oklahoma
evidence_summary: Includes Dustin Bridges; Richard Henderson; William ONeal among the wider storm fatalities
limitations: Wider storm list includes flooding; early ratings and ages have conflicts
conclusion_or_follow_up: Cross-check identities with available obituary and family reporting; do not import early rating or ages

claim: Family reporting names Maria Pol Martin and Rey Chicoj Pol
source_title: Language Barriers Hinder Storm Warnings in Okla.
publisher_or_author: Juliana Keeping / The Oklahoman via EMS World
evidence_summary: Names mother and child killed on Interstate 40 by El Reno tornado
limitations: Syndicated article; no victim photographs copied
conclusion_or_follow_up: Use public names only and preserve source

claim: Two selected storm photos carry CC BY 2.0 attribution terms
source_title: El Reno tornado original photograph pages
access_level: full description pages and original files
evidence_summary: Both files credit Daniel Rodriguez and CC BY 2.0
limitations: Source filenames retain superseded EF5 label; camera time unregistered
conclusion_or_follow_up: Preserve bytes and credit; separate from timed map observations

claim: Dustin Bridges obituary supplies his full public name
publisher_or_author: Jones-Harkins Funeral Home via Tribute Archive
evidence_summary: Dustin Heath Bridges; date and place of death
limitations: An obituary alone does not establish storm-wide totals
conclusion_or_follow_up: Use name only with contemporary reporting link

claim: William ONeal obituary is a supplementary identity lead
evidence_summary: Matching public name and event date
limitations: Direct page retrieval failed; full obituary not read
conclusion_or_follow_up: Keep contemporary reporting as the displayed primary source
